about: Scintilla prediction-markets topic registry. Edit this file to add, drop or re-point a topic; the collector (supabase/functions/prediction-markets) reads it on every pass after a redeploy, and the master-tab page reads its copy at deliverables/20260928/prediction-markets/topics.json (a test keeps the two identical). Every id below was checked open and priced on 28 Sep 2026 ~16:30Z. 28 Sep (N6): 23 Polymarket-only topics added (Japan and the carry trade, China–Taiwan, oil and OPEC, inflation prints, Washington, AI, the ECB, gold, the 30-year yield, GDP, the largest company). A topic with a 'roll' follows its market at expiry: mode 'next' reads the rank-th soonest live market in the Polymarket series (the Fed topics are the next three meetings), mode 'follow' keeps the pinned market until it expires and then the next one in its series. Topic ids keep their first name so the history stays joined; the event actually read is stored on every row (event_id).

polymarket.reads: gamma-api.polymarket.com /events/{id} (prices, volume), data-api.polymarket.com /oi (open interest). Public, no account, no key.
polymarket.terms_note: Public read endpoints; published limits are far above what this uses (Gamma /events 500 req per 10 s). The Terms of Use page body could not be read (rendered by script), so data-use terms are UNVERIFIED.

kalshi.reads: api.elections.kalshi.com/trade-api/v2 /markets?event_ticker= (prices, volume, open interest). Public, no account, no key.
kalshi.terms_note: OFF until Alan decides. Kalshi's docs say using the API binds you to its Developer Agreement; two independent summaries of that agreement (v1.1, section 3) quote API use as limited to facilitating a member's own trading, with caching or redistributing market data disallowed. The primary page answered HTTP 429 to us, so the exact wording is unverified. Set enabled to true and redeploy to switch it on; every Kalshi id below is already mapped and was checked live.

topics.label: Fed decision · the next meeting
topics.plain: What the Fed does to its policy rate at its next meeting (28 Oct 2026 today). Each row is the chance of that one result. When the meeting's market expires, this topic moves to the next meeting by itself; the topic id keeps its first date so the history stays joined.

topics.label: Fed decision · the meeting after
topics.plain: The meeting after the next one (9–10 Dec 2026 today). Same five results. Moves up one meeting by itself when the next one's market expires.

topics.label: Fed decision · the third meeting out
topics.plain: Three meetings out (27 Jan 2027 today). Moves up one meeting by itself when the next one's market expires.

topics.label: How many Fed hikes in 2026
topics.plain: Total number of 0.25-point hikes across all 2026 meetings.

topics.label: How many Fed cuts in 2026
topics.plain: Total number of 0.25-point cuts in 2026. Near 100% on 'none' means the market sees no cut this year.

topics.label: 10-year Treasury yield, rest of 2026
topics.plain: Kalshi asks where the 10-year CLOSES on 31 Dec ('at or above'). Polymarket asks how high or low it TOUCHES before 2027. Different questions: read them next to each other, do not subtract them.

topics.label: 2-year Treasury yield, end of Q3 2026
topics.plain: Where the 2-year par yield ends September. Kalshi only; Polymarket lists no 2-year market. This one resolves on 30 Sep and needs a new id after that.

topics.label: S&P 500 by year-end
topics.plain: Kalshi: the 31 Dec closing range, and whether 2026 finishes positive. Polymarket: which levels the S&P TOUCHES by end of December. Different questions.

topics.label: S&P (SPY) this month
topics.plain: Which SPY prices get touched during the month. Polymarket only; Kalshi has no open monthly S&P market today. Rolls to next month's market by itself when this month's expires.

topics.label: US recession in 2026
topics.plain: Chance the US is judged to be in recession in 2026. The two venues word the rules differently (Kalshi goes by the NBER call), so small gaps are expected.

topics.label: US recession by end of 2027
topics.plain: Same idea one year further out.

topics.label: US–Iran ceasefire holds through…
topics.plain: Chance the US–Iran ceasefire is still holding at each date. Polymarket only.

topics.label: Israel–Iran ceasefire holds through…
topics.plain: Chance the Israel–Iran ceasefire is still holding at each date. Polymarket only.

topics.label: US announces end of the Iran blockade by…
topics.plain: Chance the US announces the blockade is over by each date. Polymarket only.

topics.label: US invades Iran before 2027
topics.plain: Chance of a US ground invasion of Iran before 2027. Polymarket only.

topics.label: US–Iran nuclear deal by…
topics.plain: Chance of a final US–Iran nuclear deal by each date. Kalshi's 'before 1 Nov' is lined up with Polymarket's '31 Oct', and so on.

topics.label: Russia–Ukraine ceasefire by…
topics.plain: Chance of a Russia–Ukraine ceasefire by each date. Polymarket only; Kalshi has no open ceasefire market.

topics.label: Russia–Ukraine peace talks by…
topics.plain: Chance of formal Russia–Ukraine peace talks by each date. Polymarket only.

topics.label: NATO–Russia military clash by…
topics.plain: Chance of a direct NATO–Russia military clash by each date. Polymarket only.

topics.label: Putin out as president by…
topics.plain: Chance Putin is no longer president by each date. Polymarket only.

topics.label: US tariff rate on China, year-end
topics.plain: Polymarket: which band the tariff on Chinese goods is in on 31 Dec. Kalshi: whether it is at or above each level on 1 Jan 2027. Different wording.

topics.label: New US trade deals in 2026
topics.plain: Which countries sign a new trade deal with the US before 2027. Each row is one country.

topics.label: US effective tariff rate, Q3 2026
topics.plain: The average tariff actually paid on imports in Q3. Kalshi only.

topics.label: Who wins the House, Nov 2026
topics.plain: Which party controls the House after the midterms.

topics.label: Who wins the Senate, Nov 2026
topics.plain: Which party controls the Senate after the midterms.

topics.label: Balance of power after the midterms
topics.plain: The four ways the House and Senate can split.

topics.label: 30-year Treasury yield, highest before 2027
topics.plain: How high the 30-year yield TOUCHES before 2027. Polymarket only. Each row is one level.

topics.label: US GDP growth in 2026
topics.plain: Which band US economic growth for 2026 lands in, as first reported. Polymarket only; rolls to the next market in its series when this one expires.

topics.label: Largest company in the world, end of 2026
topics.plain: Which company is the biggest by market value on 31 Dec. Polymarket only. Rolls to the next market in its series after it expires.

topics.label: Bank of Japan decision · the next meeting
topics.plain: What the Bank of Japan does at its next meeting (30 Oct 2026 today). A Japanese hike makes borrowing yen dearer, which is what unwinds the carry trade. Polymarket only; moves to the next meeting by itself.

topics.label: Bank of Japan decision · the meeting after
topics.plain: The Bank of Japan meeting after the next one (18 Dec 2026 today). Polymarket only; moves up one meeting by itself.

topics.label: Dollar–yen (USD/JPY) levels touched in 2026
topics.plain: Which dollar–yen levels get touched before the end of 2026. A fast fall in USD/JPY (a stronger yen) is the carry-trade alarm. Polymarket only.

topics.label: China invades Taiwan before 2027
topics.plain: Chance of a Chinese invasion of Taiwan before 2027. Polymarket only; rolls to the next market in its series after it expires.

topics.label: China blockades Taiwan in 2026
topics.plain: Chance China blockades Taiwan in 2026. Polymarket only.

topics.label: China–Taiwan military clash before 2027
topics.plain: Chance of a direct military clash between China and Taiwan before 2027. Polymarket only.

topics.label: WTI crude oil · levels touched this month
topics.plain: Which oil prices get touched during the month. Polymarket only; rolls to next month's market by itself.

topics.label: Crude oil at an all-time high by…
topics.plain: Chance oil sets a new all-time high by each date. Polymarket only.

topics.label: Another country leaves OPEC in 2026
topics.plain: Chance another member quits OPEC this year. Polymarket only.

topics.label: Strait of Hormuz traffic back to normal by…
topics.plain: Chance shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, where about a fifth of the world's oil passes, is back to normal by the soonest date listed. Polymarket only; moves to the next date by itself.

topics.label: US inflation (CPI, year on year) · the next print
topics.plain: Which band the next US consumer-price print lands in (September's, out 15 Oct today). Polymarket only; moves to the next month's print by itself.

topics.label: US core CPI (year on year) · the next print
topics.plain: Core inflation (without food and energy) for the next print. Polymarket only; moves to the next print by itself.

topics.label: US core PCE (year on year) · the next print
topics.plain: The Fed's preferred inflation gauge for the next print (August's, out 30 Sep today). Polymarket only; moves to the next print by itself.

topics.label: How high US inflation gets in 2026
topics.plain: Chance US inflation goes above each level at some point in 2026. Polymarket only.

topics.label: US government shutdown
topics.plain: Chance the federal government shuts down when its funding runs out on 1 Oct, and a second market pairing another shutdown with who wins the House. Polymarket only; these markets have no series, so when they expire the card keeps its last reading and says so.

topics.label: US debt: default or another downgrade before 2027
topics.plain: No debt-ceiling market is open (the ceiling was raised in 2025). These two are the nearest: the US missing a debt payment, and another credit-rating downgrade, before 2027. Polymarket only.

topics.label: The AI bubble bursts by…
topics.plain: Chance the market judges the AI bubble to have burst by each date, as Polymarket's rules define it. The "AI slowdown" story in one number. Polymarket only.

topics.label: AI regulation: a US safety bill, or a federal framework
topics.plain: Chance the US enacts an AI safety bill before 2027, and a comprehensive federal AI law before 2028. Polymarket only.

topics.label: ECB decision · the next meeting
topics.plain: What the European Central Bank does at its next meeting (30 Oct 2026 today). Polymarket only; moves to the next meeting by itself.

topics.label: Gold · levels touched this month
topics.plain: Which gold prices get touched during the month. Polymarket only; rolls to next month's market by itself.
